regression_check.rationale: The cycle-1 dispatch was prose-correction-and-annotation only (Edit Sets 1-7 in dispatch-r1.json), bounded to label corrections, an annotation, a Context reword, and two new ordered Plan-tasks. No new architectural decisions; no new ADR authoring; no FR-1..FR-7 design change; no carve-out expansion. The risk surface for new findings was therefore narrow: (a) had the corrections introduced new contradictions (e.g., changed install_complete somewhere it should have stayed primary_degraded as a sub-field), or (b) had the row 70 annotation accidentally weakened ADR-0041's decision text, or (c) had the ADR-0057 Context reword undermined the §Decision section. None of these regressions appears: (a) sub-field-of-structured_failure references to primary_degraded are correctly preserved in ADR-0037 §Decision item 2, item 3, Architecture Impact fallback-detection site, and in ADR-0058 §Options Considered Option 1 (Interpretation B discussion). (b) ADR-0041 row 70's annotation is bracketed and explicitly notes 'Decision content of ADR-0041 unchanged; prose-only annotation per ADR-0005 hygiene' — the rest of the table is untouched. (c) ADR-0057's §Decision section preserves the original 'Introduce …' verb (per dispatch direction) and the §Context entry-point above it sets the reader's mental model correctly before they reach that verb.
